scheme.scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
scheme.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
scheme.description: Investment of over Rs 75,000 crore. Subsidy for residential households: Rs 30,000/kW up to 2 kW; Rs 18,000/kW for additional capacity up to 3 kW; total subsidy for systems larger than 3 kW capped at Rs 78,000. GHS/RWA: Rs 18,000/kW for common facilities up to 500 kW. Special states: additional 10% subsidy per kW. Online application at pmsuryaghar.gov.in.
scheme.voice_summary: PM Surya Ghar gives households a subsidy of up to 78000 rupees for rooftop solar panels, and up to 300 units of free electricity a month.
benefits: Rs 30,000 per kW subsidy for residential households (up to 2 kW)
Rs 18,000 per kW for additional capacity between 2-3 kW
Total subsidy capped at Rs 78,000 for systems larger than 3 kW
Up to 300 units of free electricity per month
eligibility: Must have registered DISCOM electricity connection
Roof must be feasible for solar installation (DISCOM approval)
documents: Proof of Roof Ownership / Electricity Connection
application_process: offline: Net meter physical inspection and installation by DISCOM field team.
online: Register on National Portal for PM Surya Ghar (pmsuryaghar.gov.in) by selecting State, Distribution Company (DISCOM), and Consumer Account Number.
online: Apply for Rooftop Solar installation by submitting roof area and sanctioned load details.
online: Wait for DISCOM feasibility approval online.
online: Select a registered vendor and get the rooftop solar plant installed.
online: Submit plant details and apply for net meter inspection.
online: Upon DISCOM inspection and commissioning certificate generation, submit bank account details for direct subsidy disbursement.

procedure_steps.text: Net meter physical inspection and installation by DISCOM field team.
Register on National Portal for PM Surya Ghar (pmsuryaghar.gov.in) by selecting State, Distribution Company (DISCOM), and Consumer Account Number.
Apply for Rooftop Solar installation by submitting roof area and sanctioned load details.
Wait for DISCOM feasibility approval online.
Select a registered vendor and get the rooftop solar plant installed.
Submit plant details and apply for net meter inspection.
Upon DISCOM inspection and commissioning certificate generation, submit bank account details for direct subsidy disbursement.

faqs.question: How much subsidy is provided under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana?
faqs.answer: The scheme provides subsidy of Rs. 30,000 for 1 kW systems, Rs. 60,000 for 2 kW systems, and Rs. 78,000 for 3 kW or higher systems, providing up to 300 units of free electricity monthly.

catalog_descriptions.en: PM Surya Ghar gives households a subsidy of up to 78000 rupees for rooftop solar panels, and up to 300 units of free electricity a month.
catalog_descriptions.hi: पीएम सूर्य घर घरों को छत पर सौर पैनलों के लिए 78000 रुपये तक की सब्सिडी देता है, और एक महीने में 300 यूनिट तक मुफ्त बिजली देता है।
catalog_descriptions.ta: பிரதமர் சூர்யா கர், வீடுகளுக்கு ரூஃபோப் சோலார் பேனல்களுக்கு 78000 ரூபாய் வரை மானியமும், மாதத்திற்கு 300 யூனிட் வரை இலவச மின்சாரமும் வழங்குகிறது.
